title: Summarize all matching customer order evidence by currency and exact unit
description: Users see server-derived all-matching summary panels beside current-page customer/currency rows. Derive summaries from the same complete bounded scoped filtered CustomerShipmentItem list before paging or selected-column projection; do not fetch a second source or sum displayed-page rows. Add pure summary rules and narrow DTOs. Currency amount summary has one bucket per existing raw currency group key, known signed decimal TotalAmount, distinct CustomerId count and sum of disjoint OrderCount, preserving zero/negative values. Unknown/invalid currency buckets retain existing distinct raw keys, amount=null, explicit unknown counts/basis; never combine currencies or round each customer before summing. Exact-unit quantity summary groups existing UnitGroups within each currency by ordinal raw unit identity; sum known signed quantities and DetailCount, unknown-unit quantity remains null with count, no unit conversion/normalization. Monetary totals belong only to currency panel, never duplicated over unit rows. Missing/incomplete source details retain explicit per-customer-currency completeness reasons and incomplete bucket count; unit summaries are observed nondeleted detail evidence, never claim complete ordered quantities. Empty source and out-of-range current page are distinct: all-matching summaries stay available on empty page, independent of hidden fields, with date/filter/caps/coverage and approved-order evidence. Counts across units are detail counts, not unique order/customer counts. Preserve legacy and detail downloads. Development only: reuse the existing customer-shipment menu, fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService, approved nondeleted SalesOrders/SalesOrderDetails and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Evidence remains approved sales orders, never actual shipment/stock-out/container/collected-revenue evidence. All endpoints recheck identity/menu/data scope, fail closed on invalid inputs, revoked permissions and bounded source overflow; no client identity/scope/rows/amounts as authority or permission expansion. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct business table writes, domain entities or persistence schema changes, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests and configured safe Release build/test; any unavailable external database/browser acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Pure pre-page summaries cover all matching bounded scoped customer/currency rows, with per-currency signed known amounts and unique-customer/order counts, unknown currency nulls and no cross-currency total.
Within each currency, exact-unit observed detail quantities/counts remain separate; unknown units and incomplete source reasons stay explicit and no monetary amount is duplicated across unit groups.

Preview/designer show separate all-matching currency and unit panels with filter/date/cap/coverage context even on empty pages or hidden fields; focused summary/API/UI/detail-export regressions and safe Release build/test pass.
